description: This is a SwiftUI view component implementing a Tailscale integration settings section in an application. It manages modes, status, authentication, and configuration for Tailscale, including UI elements and configuration persistence.

classes.name: GatewayTailscaleMode
classes.description: An enumeration representing the Tailscale mode, with options off, serve, and funnel, each with associated label, description, and an identifiable id.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing the Tailscale configuration, status display, and user interactions for the application.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current Tailscale configuration from persistent storage and updates the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates and applies configuration changes, updating the persistent store and triggering gateway restart if necessary.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Static async function that constructs the Tailscale configuration object, saves it to disk, and returns success status and error message if any.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Restarts the gateway process if in local connection mode and not paused.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Starts a periodic timer to check Tailscale status regularly.
